_readme: S369 SkyLaurel, 2026-10-12. San Diego City's capture (run 38197175054) loaded the registry's catalog address, a district alias view (https://sdccd.curriqunet.com/catalog/alias/city26-27/iq/15489), and its scripts named no catalog id the reader knows (_getNavigation?id=, _getActiveCatalogById/, _getPage?catalogId=), so it read no program. Sam chose San Diego City after Chaffey (2026-10-12). This read loads that address with "network": true, to see which calls the catalog's scripts make from an alias view, and the district host's catalog list as JSON. No model call; two page loads and the data calls the browser makes for the first.
